scope: Splendor core game, 1st edition (2014), complete authoritative extracted/splendor-rules.txt. No expansions or later-edition additions.

questions.question: During setup, how should the gem and gold supply be arranged: are all tokens mixed together or sorted, how many distinct piles are made, and where should they be placed relative to players?

At the end of the final round you have twelve prestige printed on purchased developments, one acquired noble, four unspent gold and five other gem tokens. What is your final prestige score? Do leftover gold or gem tokens add points?
